items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 5 sets of keys, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam.

Second guard has arrived; commencing patrols and routes.

Welfare check at McDonald's Britomart, Starbucks, Kowhai Cafe, all clear.
77 Convenience Store corner of Commerce and Quay Street

Tony's Original Steakhouse and Seafood Restaurant

Check-in at corner of Wellesley Street East and Lorne Street, all clear.
Welfare check at Shortland Street Convenience Store, Taco Bell, North Face, Haven Mart, UGG Shoes, Hoka, all clear.

Mistry Shoe Repair and Key Cutting
Dilworth Building entrance Customs Street East

Welfare check at Peppers Cafe, City Convenience Store, Sierra Cafe Albert Street, Mr Barber Training Centre, all clear.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 21:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Bodycam, 5 x Keys.
Debrief completed; gearing up and commencing patrols.
Response call from Mirrou regarding a theft that took place, involving one male adult and one female adult last seen walking down Queen Street.
Patrolled the whole of Queen Street — no sign of the suspected individuals; patrolling the Britomart area to potentially spot them.
Unable to locate the suspected individuals after an extended search; heading to Mirrou.
Arrived at Mirrou; one guard standing by outside and one guard inside speaking with staff.
Response call from Mountain Warehouse regarding a male individual suspected of shoplifting; staff advised he walked down Queen Street to Vulcan Lane. Running to the area to catch the individual.
After an extended search through Vulcan Lane and up and down High Street, the male described by staff could not be found in the area; patrolling Lorne Street.
Call from Lovisa regarding a male individual who walked out of the store with stolen products in his possession; running down to catch up with the individual.
Call from Auckland compliance warden Anas advising the individual had made his way through Vulcan Lane; running up Vulcan Lane to intercept the individual with the stolen goods.
After an extended pursuit, the male described by staff could not be located; standing by maintaining presence at the bottom of O'Connell Street.
Full sweep of O'Connell Street, all clear; patrolling down Shortland Street.

While maintaining presence on Shortland Street in front of Haven Mart, spotted an individual matching the description of the Mountain Warehouse offender walking up High Street towards Freyberg Place; following to confirm suspicions.
Arrived at Freyberg Place; patrolling the area to find the individual.
Freyberg Place, Chancery Square, O'Connell and Chancery Street; welfare checks on all businesses in the area, all clear.
Response call from Tank on Elliott Street regarding a male individual outside the premises shouting and swearing; en route to the location.
Arrived at the response location; the male was nowhere to be seen — standing by in case the individual returns.
No clear sign of the described individual in the area; continuing patrols down Elliott Street.
Full sweep of Elliott Street with welfare checks, all clear; maintaining presence at Elliott Stables:
Response call from Tank regarding the same described individual again shouting, swearing and disturbing the public peace; en route to the location.

Located the male described by Tank staff; approached kindly and asked if he was alright. He came off very aggressive and loud towards the public and would not listen when asked to keep it down — possibly under the influence of illegal substances. Following the individual from a safe distance in case of any issues.
Individual stopped in the middle of Victoria Street shouting and screaming.
Individual moving down to Albert Street.
Following the individual down Wellesley Street; still very loud and disturbing the public peace.

After a long follow at a safe distance the individual finally calmed down; we approached, asked him nicely to keep the volume down, and he was now very compliant. Standing down; heading back to Headquarters to charge the Ops Phone.
Arrived at Headquarters; charging the Ops Phone due to low percentage (18:48–19:42).
Response call from McDonald's Queen Street regarding a female individual who had been sleeping inside the premises for almost two hours; en route to the location.
Arrived at the response location; the female was safely escorted out of the premises. Standing by outside until she left the area.
Welfare check at McDonald's Queen Street, Avachi, 77 Convenience Store, Timezone centre, all clear; patrolling up Queen Street.
Road blocked off going up to Aotea Square due to a protest; maintaining presence for any issues.
Standing down from the top of Queen Street, all clear; patrolling up Wellesley to Elliott Stables.
Welfare check at Father Teds, all clear.
Arrived at Elliott Stables maintaining presence.
Welfare check on Elliott Stables and the static guard, all clear; heading back to HQ.
Heading down Elliott Street, encountered a group of individuals drinking alcohol in a public space; successfully removed the alcohol and continued the route.
Afternoon Shift concluded; handing over to the Night Shift.

sections.title: Night Shift (21:30 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Response call from Jo & Joes regarding a female vagrant threatening to assault the staff member on shift; routing to the location.
Arrived at the location; no female matching the description seen around the area. Standing by outside in case of any issues.
Welfare check at Jo & Joes, all clear; heading back to Headquarters.
Arrived at Headquarters; standing by in the office charging the Ops Phone before commencing full patrols (22:01–23:00).
Full sweep of Darby Street; arrived at Bar 101, standing by maintaining presence.
Welfare check at Bar 101, all clear, no issues to report.
Full sweep of Queen Street; welfare check at 77 Convenience Store, all clear. Arrived at Britomart patrolling the area.
Welfare check on Britomart, McDonald's and staff, all clear; patrolling down Quay Street.
Welfare check on Kemuri and the guard, all clear; maintaining presence at Reign N Pour.
Welfare check at Reign N Pour, all clear, no issues to report.
Full sweep of Quay Street; commencing welfare checks through the Viaduct.
Still patrolling the Viaduct; commencing sweep of the area.
Full sweep of the Viaduct; welfare checks at Lulas Sweatshop, Danny Doolans, Rosies Hot Cantina, all clear. Patrolling down Quay Street.
Welfare check of Quay Street, all clear; maintaining presence at Reign N Pour.
Welfare check at Reign N Pour and on the Kemuri guard, all clear, no issues.
Arrived at Britomart; commencing sweep of the area.
Britomart full sweep and McDonald's welfare check all clear. Call received from a fellow guard at Bar 101 reporting a big altercation between two parties on Darby Street; en route to the location.
Arrived at the response location; no altercation observed between the two parties. Standing by at Bar 101 in case of any further issues.
Full sweep of Elliott Street; welfare checks at Dominos, Wilson Carpark, Mr Snack, Chicken n Chips n Fish, Bar 101 and the guards, all clear, no issues.
Half of Victoria Street all clear; welfare check at Skymart Convenience Store, all clear. Patrolling through Albert Street.
Half of Albert Street all clear, no issues; maintaining presence at Ace Karaoke.
Welfare check at Ace Karaoke bar and the guard, all clear; arrived at Federal Square commencing sweep of the area.
Full sweep of Federal Square, no issues confirmed in the area; patrolling down Wyndham Street.
Full sweep of Wyndham Street; welfare check at QFTAV bar, all clear. Patrolling up Queen Street.
Full sweep of Queen Street, all clear; arrived at Bar 101, standing by maintaining presence for any issues.
Bar 101 has closed; standing by maintaining presence until the crowd clears out.
Crowd outside Bar 101 all clear; escorting a fellow guard to Headquarters.
Let the fellow guard into Level 1, all clear, no issues to report; continuing patrols up Victoria.
Victoria Street all clear, no issues; patrolling High Street.
Arrived at Freyberg Place; commencing sweep of the area.
Full sweep of Freyberg Place, O'Connell Street and Chancery Street, all clear; patrolling down High Street.
Full sweep of Vulcan Lane, all clear, no issues to report.
Full sweep of the whole of High Street, all clear; patrolling down Fort Lane.
Full sweep of Fort Lane; welfare checks at Wilson Carpark and Jo & Joes, all clear. Patrolling through Fort Lane to Britomart.
Welfare check at Customs Convenience Store, all clear; arrived at Britomart commencing sweep of the area.

Britomart full sweep and McDonald's welfare check all clear. Response call from McDonald's Queen Street regarding a group of individuals sleeping inside the premises while staff attempt a full clean-up; en route to the location.
Arrived at the response location; all customers and the group of individuals were temporarily outside until the clean-up was done — no further issues. Heading back to HQ.
Arrived at Headquarters; charging the Ops Phone.
Commencing 30-minute break while the Ops Phone charges.

flags: STAFFING: Morning ran a single guard 06:38–07:15 until the second guard arrived; patrols commenced 07:19.
SHIFT TIMES: Afternoon shift concluded at 21:30 (not 22:30); Night Shift commenced 21:35.
QA: 15:53 caller name logged as 'Anus' in the raw record; rendered as 'Anas' (presumed typo for the Auckland compliance warden's name).
QA: Three consecutive theft response calls (14:52 Mirrou, 15:24 Mountain Warehouse, 15:47 Lovisa) — no offenders located despite extended pursuits.
